def _create_sample_doc(tmp_path, content=""):
    """Create a minimal Doorstop document with optional content."""
    doc_path = tmp_path / "doc.txt"
    doc_path.write_text(content)
    return doc_path

def _build_tree(tmp_path):
    """Build a Doorstop tree from the temporary directory."""
    return builder.build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
